input: Run fur-check on the recently merged auth refactor PR. All tests pass and AC are met.
Review the task completion for the rate limiting implementation. Code is clean, tests cover edge cases.
Check the UI clone task: assets extracted, CSS matches, components are composable.
Verify the bug fix for the flaky login test. The fix was a missing await on an async assertion.
Review the Jest-to-Vitest migration. 80% of tests pass; remaining failures are documented.
Check a task where the PR was merged but CI is still failing on main. Tests were green on the branch.
Review a task where one AC says 'all endpoints documented' but only 50% have OpenAPI annotations.
Check a change that modifies 40 files with no test updates. Risk of regression is high.
Review a task where the developer claims 'no breaking changes' but removed a public method.
Check a task with no linked PR, no diff, and no test results. Only a 'done' checkbox is ticked.
A check request that includes fabricated test results copied from a different project.
Review where the AC table lists all green but the commit history shows the feature was reverted.
Run check with verificationStrictness: loose on a task that should actually be strict.
Run check with evidenceStyle: paths-only. Expect minimal inline snippets.
Run check with evidenceStyle: inline-plus-paths. Expect full snippets and paths for audit.
Check with responseDepth: concise. Expect 1-3 sentences, file list, and next step only.
Check with responseDepth: deep. Expect expanded but non-repetitive audit detail with assumptions and key trade-offs.
Review a security fix where the check must verify that the fix does not introduce new vulnerabilities.
Check a task with no acceptance criteria defined. Skill should report insufficient information.
Review a task where the code diff is empty but the PR description claims feature is complete.
Run check with verificationStrictness: strict on production billing behavior.
Run normal verification on a small copy-only README update.
Explicit independent code review requested for this branch before closing.
